aria-label.zh-CN: 步骤条的可访问名称，传入后根元素带 `role="group"`。
aria-label.en-US: Accessible name of the steps; the root element gets `role="group"` when it is set.

children.zh-CN: 步骤，通常为 `Steps.Step`。每个 React 元素占一个步骤位置，文本与空值不计入；原生元素原样渲染，不接收步骤属性。
children.en-US: Steps, usually `Steps.Step`. Each React element takes one step position; text and empty values are not counted. Native elements render as they are and receive no step props.

className.en-US: Class name of the root element.

current.zh-CN: 当前步骤，从 0 开始计数，未设置时为 `0`。子 Step 可用 `status` 覆盖自己的状态。
current.en-US: Current step, counting from 0; defaults to `0`. A child Step can override its own state with `status`.

direction.zh-CN: 步骤条方向，可选 `horizontal` 或 `vertical`，未设置时为 `horizontal`。用于 `fill` 与 `basic` 类型，`nav` 类型忽略。
direction.en-US: Direction of the steps: `horizontal` or `vertical`, defaults to `horizontal`. Applies to the `fill` and `basic` types; ignored by `nav`.

hasLine.zh-CN: 是否显示步骤间的连接线，未设置时为 `true`。仅用于 `basic` 类型。
hasLine.en-US: Whether to show the line between steps, defaults to `true`. Applies to the `basic` type only.

initial.zh-CN: 起始序号，从 0 开始计数，未设置时为 `0`。步骤的序号等于 `initial` 加其在子元素中的索引。
initial.en-US: Starting index, counting from 0; defaults to `0`. A step's number equals `initial` plus its index among the children.

onChange.zh-CN: 选择步骤时调用，参数为该步骤的序号（`initial` 加索引）；点击当前步骤不调用。传入后所有步骤变为可点击。
onChange.en-US: Called when a step is selected, with its number (`initial` plus index); not called for the current step. Passing it makes every step clickable.

prefixCls.zh-CN: 类名前缀，内部用于生成样式类名。
prefixCls.en-US: Class name prefix, used internally to generate style class names.

size.zh-CN: 尺寸，可选 `small` 或 `default`，未设置时为 `default`。用于 `basic` 与 `nav` 类型。
size.en-US: Size: `small` or `default`, defaults to `default`. Applies to the `basic` and `nav` types.

status.zh-CN: 当前步骤的状态，可选 `wait`、`process`、`finish`、`error` 或 `warning`，未设置时为 `process`。用于 `fill` 与 `basic` 类型。
status.en-US: Status of the current step: `wait`, `process`, `finish`, `error` or `warning`, defaults to `process`. Applies to the `fill` and `basic` types.

type.zh-CN: 步骤条类型，可选 `fill`、`basic` 或 `nav`。

className.en-US: Class name of the step item (root element).

description.zh-CN: 步骤的详情描述。`nav` 类型不渲染。
description.en-US: Description of the step. Not rendered by the `nav` type.

icon.zh-CN: 自定义图标，替换状态图标；内容为空时不显示图标。`nav` 类型不渲染。
icon.en-US: Custom icon that replaces the status icon; an empty value shows no icon. Not rendered by the `nav` type.

onClick.zh-CN: 点击步骤项时调用，包括点击其中的控件时。传入后步骤可点击，`role` 默认为 `button`；先于 Steps 的 `onChange` 调用。
onClick.en-US: Called when the step item is clicked, including clicks on controls inside it. Passing it makes the step clickable with `role` defaulting to `button`; it runs before the `onChange` of Steps.

ref.en-US: Reference to the step item (root element, `div`).

status.zh-CN: 该步骤自己的状态，可选 `wait`、`process`、`finish`、`error` 或 `warning`。未设置时随 Steps 的 `current` 与 `status` 决定。`nav` 类型不生效。
status.en-US: Own status of the step: `wait`, `process`, `finish`, `error` or `warning`. When omitted it follows `current` and `status` of Steps. Not applied by the `nav` type.

style.en-US: Style of the step item (root element).
